title: Silent Letters
rule: In some words one letter is silent. In kn words the k is silent. In wr words the w is silent. In gn words the g is silent. In words ending mb, the b is silent.
trickText: Say the word. Which letter do you NOT hear? kn: no k sound. wr: no w sound. gn: no g sound. mb: no b sound.
say: Today's case: silent letters. Some words have a letter you cannot hear. Say the word and listen. Which letter is silent?

activities.instruction: Listen to the word. Which letter is silent?
